# recovery-old-agent-vm-vault-system

Frozen agent-vm dispatch / status state. Useful as fixture data for
control-plane replay tests; not a runtime input.

## Stack & contents

~12,875 files. Top-level dominated by archived dispatch JSON (github-trending, reddit-intel, utility-task, competitive-scan) under `agent-vm/dispatch/archive/cleared-20260422/` plus active-tasks/agent-status snapshots.

## Why this is here

**Fixture data**, not runtime. Use as event_log replay corpus when testing `codebase-ema/code/ema/daemon/lib/ema/control_plane/replay.ex`.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/recovery-old-agent-vm-vault-system:agent-vm/dispatch/active-tasks.json | head -40
git ls-tree origin/recovery-old-agent-vm-vault-system:agent-vm/dispatch/archive/cleared-20260422 | head
```
